title: Error: Parameter "synth" is null when getting TTS voices while running game through Steam client
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4.1
- Error happens on macOS, Linux
- Error does not happen on Windows

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Linux Mint 22.1 (Xia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER (nvidia; 550.144.03) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700KF CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

I'm not sure if this is an Godot or a Steam issue, or a GodotSteam plugin issue so apologies if this is the wrong place.
My game uses text to speech and works perfectly fine when exported and run. I'm getting the OS voices at startup and store them for the settings script.

However, when I upload the game to Steamworks and play it through the Steam client, I'm getting the following errors:

```
ERROR: Parameter "synth" is null.
   at: get_voices (platform/linuxbsd/tts_linux.cpp:195)
------------ VOICE DEBUG------------------------------------------
en
ERROR: Parameter "synth" is null.
   at: get_voices (platform/linuxbsd/tts_linux.cpp:195)
getting linux voices 0: []
ERROR: Parameter "synth" is null.
   at: get_voices (platform/linuxbsd/tts_linux.cpp:195)
getting linux voices 1: []
ERROR: Parameter "synth" is null.
   at: get_voices (platform/linuxbsd/tts_linux.cpp:195)
getting linux voices 2: []
No voices found for language en
```

No voices are found and the TTS will not play but if I open the folder of the game, and launch it myself, it works perfectly fine again (as in the identical game file). It seems that the Steam wrapper interferes somehow with DisplayServer.tts_get_voices_for_language(). Windows seems to be unaffected. 

Here's the code of how I'm loading the voices:

```
func load_voices(_language: String = DEFAULT_LANGUAGE) -> Array:
	voices.clear()
	
	# Get voice based on the the OS.
	print("GETTING TTS VOICES -------------------------")
	print(OS.get_name())
	match OS.get_name():
		"Windows":
			# Gets the first part of the language string
			voices_paths = DisplayServer.tts_get_voices_for_language(_language.split("-")[0])
			for voice in voices_paths:
				var voice_string = voice.split("-")[1]
				var voice_name = voice_string.split("_")[1]
				voices.append(voice_name)
			print(voices)
		"Linux":
			# Uses the whole language-locale string
			voices_paths = DisplayServer.tts_get_voices_for_language(_language)
			for voice in voices_paths:
				if voice.contains("+"):
					var voice_name = voice.split("+")[1]
					voices.append(voice_name)
				else:
					voices.append(voice)
		"macOS":
			# Gets the first part of the language string
			voices_paths = DisplayServer.tts_get_voices_for_language(_language.split("-")[0])
			print(voices_paths)
			for voice in voices_paths:
				if voice.contains("."):
					var parts = voice.split(".")
					voices.append(parts[parts.size()-1])
				else:
					voices.append(voice)
	
	# If voices are empty, print an error and return.
	if voices.is_empty():
		printerr("No voices found for language %s" % _language)
		return []
		
	return voices
```

The language is by default set to "en".

### Steps to reproduce

- load TTS voices via DisplayServer.tts_get_voices_for_language("en")
- start the game through Steam and check logs (produces error)
- start the game without Steam (doesn't produce error)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I don't know how else to reproduce than to link to my [demo](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3505230/Soulblaze/) and give you the beta code: testitest2025

Since it requires a game that runs through Steam.
